visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Replace Bubble Sort with Merge Sort
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Nested loops compare neighbours again and again, which takes about n squared steps. Sort with merge sort instead. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Merge sort halves the array about log2(n) times and does about n work per level, so it needs about n log n steps against n squared for bubble sort. For a million items that is roughly 20 million steps instead of a trillion.
